title: China launches free open-source AI avatar generator with lip sync #chinaai #aavatar #aigeneration
description: China released an open-source AI avatar generator that creates realistic talking avatars for free. Users can upload a photo and audio clip to generate avatars with perfect lip sync, smooth facial expressions, and full body motion. The technology supports multiple people in one scene with consistent character animation throughout the video. It can be run locally using ComfyUI or accessed online through a website, making advanced avatar creation accessible without cost. This innovation highlights China's growing role in AI-driven digital content creation and democratizes avatar technology for creators worldwide, enabling new possibilities in entertainment, marketing, and social media. #AIAvatarGenerator #OpenSourceAI #ChinaAI #ComfyUI #TalkingAvatars #AvatarCreation #AIAnimation #DigitalAvatars #FacialAnimation #LipSyncAI #BodyMotionAI #AIDrivenContent #TechInnovation #FreeAIGenerator #VirtualAvatars
